Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 1989
ACT X OF 1989
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th November, 1989]
No.PAB/LEGIS; 111(13)/89, dated
28-11-1989: - The Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 18th October, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st day of July, 1980.

Amendment of section 68 of Ordinance II of 1980

ACT X OF 1989
ACT X OF 1989
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th November, 1989]
No.PAB/LEGIS; 111(13)/89, dated
28-11-1989: - The Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 18th October, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 68 of Ordinance II of 1980.--In the
Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 1980, the existing section 68, shall be
numbered as subsection (1) of that section and after subsection (1), as so
numbered, the following new subsections shall be added:--
"(2) The
Government may, if it so desires, give retrospective effect to any notification
issued under this section.
(3)
Notwithstanding anything contained in any law for the time being in force, any
tax, rate, toll or fees levied, charged, collected or realized before the
commencement of this Act shall be deemed to have been validly levied, charged,
collected or realized, as if this Act was in force on the day on which such tax
was levied, charged, collected or realized."
